definitions.explanation: The practice of planning and controlling how time is spent in order to work efficiently and meet goals.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (time) and ⟦{管理|かんり}→管理：00178_kanri⟧ (management, control). Widely used in business, education, and self-improvement contexts.

- {時間管理|じかんかんり}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{徹底|てってい}する→徹底する：21452_tetteisuru⟧: to be thorough about time management
- {時間管理|じかんかんり}⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧: time management ability
- {時間管理|じかんかんり}⟦ツール→ツール：11044_tsuuru⟧: time management tool
- {時間管理|じかんかんり}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{苦手|にがて}→苦手：03513_nigate⟧: to be bad at time management
